title: One-sided limits at 0⁺ from subsequences of positive null sequences
statement: Let f : ℝ → [0, ∞] and L ∈ [0, ∞]. Suppose that for every sequence (λ_j)_{j∈ℕ} of positive reals with λ_j → 0 there is a strictly increasing φ : ℕ → ℕ with f(λ_{φ(j)}) → L as j → ∞. Then f(t) → L as t → 0⁺ (Tendsto f (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 L)).
lean_statement: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (L : ℝ≥0∞), (∀ lams : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ j, 0 < lams j) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ Tendsto (fun j => f (lams (φ j))) atTop (𝓝 L)) → Tendsto f (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 L)
